proposals.evidence: The full vṛṣṭi entry means rain. Bengali br śti and bɾɪʃʈi retain the diagnostic r-plus-retroflex-stop sequence and fit a learned regional continuation of that form; preserve spacing and source phonetics. Learned/cross-IA transmission is qualified rather than asserting ordinary inherited cluster development. Exact response: br śti.
